comparison.objective: Seat a flexible cord along a curved channel; candidate separates washers from ceramic media through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential cable routing versus bimanual sifting, orientation-dependent passage, and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: Cord seated in all channel sections versus ≥98% media recovery with every washer retained and screen released.
comparison.reason: Only generic bimanual manipulation is shared; no selective size/orientation separation is tested.
